sections.title: From first conversation to handoff.
sections.intro: The eight steps below use the current English process page’s content. Reading order runs down the left column, then down the right.

items.title: Contact Us
items.text: Contact us by phone, email or through the website. We will ask for some basic information about your property, such as recent energy bills, the address, photos of the building and details of your existing energy systems.

items.title: Initial Video Consultation
items.text: We will review the information you provide and discuss your property, current energy system, objectives and any initial questions about solar PV, heat pumps or the installation process.

items.title: Remote Feasibility Analysis
items.text: We carry out an initial feasibility analysis based on the location, Comune, available space, existing energy systems and other relevant characteristics of your property.

items.title: Site Visit
items.text: We schedule a three-hour site visit to collect the technical information required to design the appropriate solar PV and heat pump solution for your property.

items.title: Tailored Solution & Fixed-Price Proposal
items.text: We develop a detailed solution tailored to your property and provide a clear, fixed-price proposal. Once you accept the offer, we prepare the detailed implementation plan and installation schedule.

items.title: High-Quality Installation
items.text: We install the integrated solar PV and heat pump system with a focus on quality, reliability and minimal disruption to your home or agriturismo.

items.title: Turnkey Handoff
items.text: We hand over the finished system, a fully implemented turnkey solution tailored to your property.

items.title: Support
items.text: Post-installation support as needed and requested by you.

items.title: A Carefree Transition
items.text: We take care of all the details, so you don't have to. Switch to a sustainable home with minimal disruption to your daily life.

items.title: All-Inclusive Turnkey Service
items.text: We plan with your Comune and local electricity provider, apply for government subsidies, dispose of old systems, install a fully integrated sustainable system, and carry out regular servicing if requested.

items.title: From Assessment to Completion in Weeks
items.text: We can move from the initial consultation to completed installation within a matter of weeks.

sections.title: A few useful answers.
sections.intro: Native keyboard-accessible accordions. Questions below describe the current contact and process information.

items.question: How can I start a conversation?
items.answer: Contact Domus Zero by phone or email. You will be asked for basic information about your property, recent energy bills, the address, photographs and details of existing energy systems.

items.question: What happens after the first conversation?
items.answer: The process includes an initial video consultation, a remote feasibility analysis and a site visit before a tailored solution and fixed-price proposal.

items.question: Can the system include both solar PV and a heat pump?
items.answer: Domus Zero designs integrated solar PV and heat pump solutions tailored to the property.
